text: It is also availble for the 1-to-2-year visiting program. Those who do not meet the requirement of HSK score can at first apply for the Chinese Language Program for one year before studying in the relevant colleges or departments.Teaching ObjectivesTo nurture qualified and skilled talents who are well-versed in Chinese language and culture, who will have a good grasp of knowledge in international trade, management, and finance as well as the experience in operating and handling real-life projects, especially those pertaining to Chinese economy, society, and who understand the Chinese culture values, so as to meet the demands of the fast changing world economy.International Faculty GroupMost lecturers of the core & distinctive courses are fluent English-speaking lecturers recruited worldwide. All lecturers have practical experience in teaching and years of experience working in the industry. In addition, renowned scholars and practitioners will be invited to give lessons or lectures.Internship and Career DevelopmentIn order to nurture students mastering the practical skills, our university have designed a variety of social and business activities for students. We also assists students in their career development through the Center of Professional DevelopmentImmersion WeekOne week of immersion week in every semester provides students with opportunities to be exposed to industry seminars, lectures given by professors and practitioners, business forums and competitions, field trips, case studies, and group business projects and presentations to further reinforce their business knowledge and practical skills.Degree AwardedQualified student will be granted Master Degree of EconomicsCareer CounselingStudents will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, visits to companies, interview techniques, resume instructions and review, and career consultation.Future CareerThe university will help get employ chances in good companies and organizations.
